name: Python Full-Stack Web Development with Django
description: Python Full-Stack Web Development with Django
tech_stack:
Programming Language: Python 3

Framework: Django, Django REST Framework

Frontend Basics: HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap (optional)

Database: SQLite, PostgreSQL (Supabase)

Version Control: Git & GitHub

APIs: RESTful APIs

Auth: Django Auth, JWT

Deployment: Render / Railway / VPS

Tools: VS Code, Postman, pgAdmin
syllabus:
📚 Syllabus

🔹 Module 1: Python Fundamentals (Week 1–2)

Python syntax & variables

Data types (list, tuple, dict, set)

Conditional statements & loops

Functions & modules

File handling

Exception handling

Virtual environments & pip

🔹 Module 2: Advanced Python (Week 3)

OOP concepts

Classes & inheritance

Decorators & generators

Working with JSON & CSV

Python best practices

🔹 Module 3: Web Basics (Week 4)

How the web works (HTTP, request/response)

HTML forms

CSS fundamentals

Intro to Bootstrap

🔹 Module 4: Django Fundamentals (Week 5–6)

Django project & app structure

URLs, views, templates

Django ORM

Models & migrations

Admin panel customization

🔹 Module 5: Database & Relationships (Week 7)

One-to-One, One-to-Many, Many-to-Many

Foreign keys & constraints

PostgreSQL with Supabase

Query optimization

🔹 Module 6: Authentication & Authorization (Week 8)

Django authentication system

Login, logout, signup

Permissions & roles

Custom user model

🔹 Module 7: Forms & Validations (Week 9)

Django forms

Model forms

Custom validations

File & image uploads

🔹 Module 8: Django REST Framework (Week 10–11)

REST concepts

Serializers

CRUD APIs

JWT authentication

API testing with Postman

🔹 Module 9: Project Development (Week 12–14)

Major Project (choose one):

Training Management System

E-commerce Backend

Student ERP

Blog + REST API

Includes:

Role-based access

API integration

Database design

Clean architecture

🔹 Module 10: Deployment & DevOps Basics (Week 15)

Environment variables

Production settings

PostgreSQL setup

Deploying Django apps

Debugging production errors

🔹 Module 11: Career & Interview Prep (Week 16)

GitHub portfolio building

Resume guidance

Django interview questions

Live project demo

Mock interviews

JavaScript basics

Express.js framework

REST API design principles

CRUD operations

Data modeling & relationships

Indexing & performance basics

Full MERN stack implementation

Authentication & authorization

Clean project structure

API integration

Performance optimization

Git & GitHub best practices

Portfolio building

MERN Stack interview questions

Resume & LinkedIn guidance

Live project demo & mock interviews

name: DATA SCIENCE Using AI & ML
description: This course is designed to equip learners with strong data science fundamentals combined with practical Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning techniques.
tech_stack: Python, NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Scikit-learn, SQL, Jupyter Notebook, TensorFlow, Keras, Git, REST APIs
syllabus:
📘Syllabus
Module 1: Python & Data Science Foundations
Python fundamentals for data science
Data types, loops, functions
NumPy for numerical computing
Pandas for data manipulation
Working with real datasets

Module 2: Data Analysis, Visualization & Statistics
Data cleaning and preprocessing
Handling missing & inconsistent data
Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
Data visualization using Matplotlib & Seaborn
Statistics & probability for data science

Module 3: Machine Learning Fundamentals
Introduction to Machine Learning
Supervised vs Unsupervised learning
Linear & Logistic Regression
KNN, Decision Trees, Random Forest
Model evaluation & performance metrics

Module 4: Artificial Intelligence & Deep Learning
AI concepts and intelligent systems
Neural Networks fundamentals
Deep Learning using TensorFlow & Keras
CNN & RNN basics
Introduction to NLP

Module 5: Projects, Deployment & Industry Practices
End-to-end data science workflow
Feature engineering & model tuning
Model deployment basics
Real-world case studies
Capstone project & presentation
